title: My suitcase didn't arrive
summary_es: Oliver llama a la aerolínea porque su maleta no llegó: la agente la localiza y le explica qué va a pasar.
prediction_prompt: A passenger phones an airline because his suitcase didn't arrive. What will the airline ask him?

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: Good morning, Sky Air customer service. This is Kim speaking. How can I help?

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: Hi. I flew from Lisbon to Manchester last night, and my suitcase didn't arrive.

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Can I have your flight number, please?

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: Yes, it was SA four one seven. We landed at about half past ten.

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: Thank you. And did you report it at the airport?

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: I tried to, but the desk had already closed when I got there.

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: I see. Don't worry, we can do it now. Can you describe the suitcase?

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: It's dark green, medium size, with a red ribbon on the handle.

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: Dark green with a red ribbon. Is your name on it?

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: Yes, there's a label with my name and phone number.

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: Good. Let me check the system. Ah, here it is.

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: Have you found it?

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: Yes. It seems your bag was put on the wrong plane. It's in Madrid at the moment.

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: Madrid? How did that happen?

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: I'm afraid there was a mistake while they were loading the plane in Lisbon.

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: Right. So when will I get it back?

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: It should arrive in Manchester tomorrow afternoon. We'll deliver it to your address.

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: Tomorrow? The problem is that my work clothes are in that bag.

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: I understand. You can spend up to eighty pounds on essential things, and we'll pay you back.

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: OK, that helps. Do I need to keep the receipts?

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: Yes, please. Send them by email with your reference number.

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: And what is the reference number?

segments.speaker: kim
segments.text: It's M, A, N, five five two nine. I'll text it to you as well.

segments.speaker: oliver
segments.text: Thanks. I was quite angry this morning, but you've been really helpful.

connected_speech.explanation_es: La *t* de *didn't* se une a la vocal de *arrive*.

connected_speech.phrase: Can I have your flight number

connected_speech.explanation_es: *had* se reduce a /əd/: es fácil no oír el *past perfect*.

connected_speech.phrase: was put on the wrong plane
connected_speech.explanation_es: *was* es débil (/wəz/) y *put on* se enlaza.

connected_speech.phrase: when will I get it back
connected_speech.explanation_es: *get it* se une; en inglés americano la *t* suena casi como una «r» suave.
